description.name: OpenVPN Access Server
description.tagline: Sells OpenVPN Access Server logins, with profile download and password change in the client area.
description.long: OpenVPN Access Server by ARPHost creates, suspends and removes OpenVPN Access Server users over SSH, in Docker or directly on the host. The client gets their login, a one click .ovpn profile download and a password change form in the client area.
